key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:36C08
name: process_unnamed_large_routine
description: A large routine of 435 instructions with no recovered name and no pseudo-code, so only its size and references are known. A pc-relative address load takes its address and two unnamed routines call it.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:372D4
name: run_data_referenced_handler
description: A 53-instruction routine whose address is loaded both absolutely and pc-relatively and which is also stored as a handler pointer in data. Four unnamed routines call it, and no pseudo-code is available.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:373A8
name: run_minimal_unnamed_routine
description: A 12-instruction routine reached through a pc-relative address load and called by one unnamed routine. No pseudo-code is available, so only its size and caller are known.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:373D8
name: run_large_handler_routine
description: A 2196-instruction routine whose address is loaded absolutely and pc-relatively and which is referenced by a handler pointer in data. Four unnamed routines call it, and no pseudo-code is available.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:39628
name: run_unnamed_block_routine
description: A 53-instruction routine reached through a pc-relative address load and called by three unnamed routines. No pseudo-code is available.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:396FC
name: run_handler_block_routine
description: A 262-instruction routine whose address is taken by an absolute move and which is referenced from a handler pointer in data. Two unnamed routines call it, and no pseudo-code is available.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:39B14
name: run_handler_table_routine
description: A 315-instruction routine whose address is loaded absolutely and pc-relatively and which is referenced from a handler pointer in data. Two unnamed routines call it, and no pseudo-code is available.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:3A000
name: run_handler_entry_routine
description: A 150-instruction routine whose address is loaded absolutely and pc-relatively and which is referenced from a handler pointer in data. Three unnamed routines call it, and no pseudo-code is available.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:3A258
name: run_address_referenced_routine
description: A 150-instruction routine reached through a pc-relative address load and called by two unnamed routines. No pseudo-code is available.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:3A4B0
name: run_very_large_routine
description: A 4275-instruction routine whose address is loaded absolutely and pc-relatively and which is referenced from a handler pointer in data. Three unnamed routines call it, and no pseudo-code is available.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Crystal:0:0000
name: start_packed_stream_unpack
description: Program entry of the Crystal file that sets the COLOR00 colour register and calls a bit-reader refill routine and a multi-bit read routine, which points to unpacking a packed stream. The pseudo-code is unavailable, so the exact decoding steps are not described.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0000
name: start_installer_program_entry
description: Program entry of the installer file that clears a block of 159 longwords and calls exec and dos library functions, including OpenLibrary, AllocMem, Open and CurrentDir. It references the text dos.library and the program name f15ii(game):F15, and on one branch it builds a quoted argument string from the command line.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:017C
name: close_installer_resources
description: Releases resources by calling dos.Close, dos.UnLock, exec.CloseLibrary, exec.Forbid, exec.FreeMem and exec.ReplyMsg. It also calls a stored function pointer when one is set and makes two calls to other unnamed routines before returning.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:01F8
name: call_indirect_function
description: Loads a function pointer from a stack-relative location, calls it at a fixed negative offset, and returns. It is a single library-style indirect call with no other work.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:022C
name: return_immediately
description: A single-instruction routine that only returns. One unnamed routine calls it and it does no work.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:022E
name: return_without_action
description: A single-instruction routine that only returns. One unnamed routine calls it and it does no work.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0230
name: dispatch_flagged_entry_operation
description: Looks up an entry from the parameter and returns minus one when the lookup finds nothing. When a flag bit in the entry is set it calls another routine with a zero offset and a value of two first, then calls a second routine with a field of the entry and returns minus one if an error flag in the context is set.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0298
name: emit_string_characters
description: Walks a zero-terminated string one character at a time. While a counter in the context stays positive it stores each character at the current buffer position and advances it, and otherwise it passes the character to another routine. It finishes by passing a sentinel to that routine and returns the string length.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0300
name: parse_command_line_arguments
description: Splits a command line into arguments on spaces, tabs and newlines, treating double-quoted text as one argument and an asterisk as an escape inside quotes. It references the text NIL: and a console window specification, and it uses dos.Input, dos.Output, dos.Open and exec.FindTask to set up the streams.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0560
name: write_install_text_records
description: Writes a sequence of text strings and fixed-width numeric fields to an open file handle through many calls. It reads one character and checks whether it is N or n, then loops over a table of entries; the pseudo-code is truncated, so later behaviour is not described.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0578
name: initialise_buffer_if_needed
description: When a buffer record has no size or its flag bit is set, it obtains a new pointer from another routine and stores it in the record, returning minus one with an error code if that pointer is zero. Otherwise it resets the size and offset fields to zero and returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:05D4
name: write_character_to_buffer
description: Writes one character into a buffer structure, expanding a line feed to a carriage return and line feed when the mode allows it. It flushes through another routine when the counter runs out, sets error flags on failure, and returns the character, a sentinel for error or zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0864
name: flush_active_buffers
description: Walks a table of 8-byte records from the last index downward. For each record whose first byte is nonzero and whose flag bit 16 is clear it calls another routine with the record value, then calls another routine with the parameter.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:08C0
name: append_string_from_context
description: Appends at most a limit of characters from a source string to the end of a destination string, both taken from a context record, and terminates the result. Before copying it makes two calls to other unnamed routines and returns the destination pointer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:08DC
name: copy_string_with_limit
description: Appends at most a given number of characters from a source string to the end of a destination string and terminates the result. It returns the destination pointer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0934
name: calculate_string_length
description: Advances a pointer until it finds the zero byte that ends a string and returns the distance from the original pointer to that terminator.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0948
name: compare_c_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings character by character. It returns minus one when the first string is smaller at the first difference, one when it is larger, and zero when both strings are equal.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0968
name: insert_freed_memory_block
description: Returns a memory block to a free list kept in the context, rounding its size up to a multiple of four bytes with a minimum of eight. It keeps the list ordered by address, merges the block with an adjacent free neighbour where they touch, and returns minus one if the block overlaps a block already in the list.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0A60
name: dispatch_handle_operation
description: Looks up an entry from the parameter and returns minus one when no entry is found. Otherwise it calls another routine with a field of the entry and the two remaining parameters, and returns minus one if an error flag in the context is set.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0AA8
name: claim_free_handle_slot
description: Finds the first free record in a table of eight-byte handle records, starting at the fourth record. It fills the record from a call made with a mode chosen from the flag bits in the parameter and stores a sequence value with the returned handle. It sets error code 24 when no record is free and error code 22 when the flags are invalid.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0C28
name: create_directory_or_record_error
description: Attempts to create a directory through dos library calls. When the create call returns zero it stores the DOS error code in the context and returns minus one; otherwise it releases the lock it obtained with dos.UnLock and returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0C64
name: free_allocated_node_list
description: Walks a linked list whose head is stored in the context and calls exec.FreeMem on each node, following the first word of each node to reach the next. It then clears the head and tail pointers of the list and returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0C94
name: replace_tracked_allocation
description: Releases the tracked block held in the context, if there is one, by calling another routine with its size. When given a nonzero argument it obtains a new block through another routine and returns a pointer just past the first word of that block, or zero if the allocation fails.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0CE0
name: dispatch_entry_operation_checked
description: Looks up an entry from the parameter and returns minus one when no entry is found. Otherwise it calls another routine with a field of the entry and the two remaining parameters, and returns minus one if an error flag in the context is set.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0D28
name: allocate_tracked_memory_record
description: Allocates a block through exec.AllocMem for the requested size and links it into a list of tracked allocations held in the context, updating the head and tail pointers. It returns a pointer twelve bytes into the block, or zero when the allocation fails.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0D94
name: allocate_block_from_free_list
description: Allocates a block of at least the requested size, rounded up to a multiple of four bytes with a minimum of eight, from a free list kept in the context. It searches for a block that fits and splits off the remainder when it is large enough. When no block fits it obtains more memory through other routines, frees it into the list and retries, and it returns zero if nothing can be obtained.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0E58
name: set_tracked_block_pointer
description: When given a nonzero pointer it calls another routine with zero and stores the pointer minus four bytes in the context as the tracked block, returning the result of that call. With a zero argument it returns zero and changes nothing.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0E80
name: flush_pending_output_entries
description: Walks a linked list of entries whose head is stored in the context. For each entry with the flag bit 2 set, the flag bit 4 clear and a nonzero pending length, it calls another routine with the entry data pointer, its start value and the pending length. It then calls another routine with the parameter.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0ED4
name: write_output_or_record_error
description: Clears the error value in the context and, when a pending-error field is set, calls another routine first. It calls dos.Write through a library offset, and when the result is minus one it stores the DOS error code and sets error code 5. It returns the write result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0F20
name: seek_file_and_return_offset
description: Calls dos.Seek through a library offset and, when the call fails, records the DOS error code and error 22. It then returns an offset built from its arguments: with mode one it adds the current position, and for other nonzero modes it derives a value from the mode and calls the seek routine again when that value is zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0F94
name: read_input_or_record_error
description: Clears the error value in the context and calls a read routine through a library offset. When the result is minus one it stores the DOS error code and sets error code 5, and it returns the read result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0FE0
name: open_file_or_record_error
description: Calls the open routine through a library offset. When it returns zero it stores the DOS error code, sets error code 2 and returns minus one; otherwise it returns the handle.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:1028
name: probe_file_access
description: Tries dos.Lock on a file and, when the lock is not obtained, tries dos.Open. When both fail it stores the DOS error code and sets error code 2 in the context. When the lock succeeds it releases it with dos.UnLock and returns minus one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:108C
name: delete_existing_file_then_open
description: When dos.Lock succeeds on a file it releases the lock and removes the file with dos.DeleteFile. It then calls dos.Open and, when that fails, stores the DOS error code, sets error code 2 and returns minus one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:10F4
name: close_open_file
description: Calls another routine first when a pending-error field in the context is set. It then calls dos.Close through a library offset and returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:1118
name: open_intuition_with_name_copy
description: Opens intuition.library through exec.OpenLibrary and, if that fails, calls another routine with the value 20 and returns. It copies a length-prefixed text string from the context into a local buffer of 80 bytes, terminates it, stores the buffer address in the context and calls another routine with the values 250 and 40 and the library base, then calls another routine with 20.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:11CC
name: compute_fixed_point_product
description: Multiplies two 32-bit fixed-point values passed in registers. It multiplies the high and low 16-bit halves of each input, combines the two cross products into the upper half and adds the low-by-low product to form the result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:11EC
name: divide_fixed_point_signed
description: Divides one 32-bit fixed-point value by another. When either operand is negative it calls another routine for the magnitude and negates the result for mixed signs; for positive operands it normalises the divisor by shifting, estimates the quotient word and corrects it, then returns the result rearranged into fixed-point form.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:121E
name: normalize_fixed_point_divide
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor using a normalised fixed-point method. It returns a 64-bit value with the quotient in the high 32 bits and the remainder in the low 32 bits.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:12B0
name: show_message_or_open_intuition
description: Copies a length-prefixed text from the context into a buffer of at most 79 characters. When a task-related field is set it writes the text and a line feed through a write routine and returns minus one. Otherwise it opens intuition.library and calls another routine with the buffer and the values 250 and 60, returning zero when that call returns one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:12D2
name: report_break_notice
description: Copies a text that begins with the string *** Break: into a local buffer and terminates it. When a task-related field is set it writes the text and a line feed through a write routine and returns minus one. Otherwise it opens intuition.library and calls another routine with the buffer and the values 250 and 60, returning zero when that call returns one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:1336
name: open_intuition_then_call
description: Opens intuition.library through exec.OpenLibrary and returns minus one if that fails. Otherwise it stores the buffer address in the context and calls another routine with the values 250 and 60 and the library base, returning zero when that call returns one and minus one otherwise.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:134E
name: call_intuition_with_buffer
description: Stores the buffer address in the context and calls another routine with that buffer, the values 250 and 60 and the library base read from the frame. It returns zero when the call returns one and minus one otherwise.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:1386
name: return_zero_constant
description: Returns a constant zero without any other operation or memory access.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:13DC
name: release_indexed_record
description: Looks up a record from its parameter and returns minus one when none is found. When the record flag bit 16 is clear it calls another routine with the record second field, clears the record pointer, and returns minus one if an error flag in the context is set. When the flag is set it clears the record pointer and returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:1424
name: lookup_handle_record
description: Clears an error flag in the context and returns the address of an eight-byte table record for an index. It returns zero and stores error code 9 when the index is negative, out of range or the record is empty.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:1464
name: check_break_signal_handler
description: Reads the task signal state through exec.SetSignal and, when the mask value 12288 is set and a handler is registered in the context, calls that handler. When the handler reports that it has handled the request, the routine clears the handler and calls another routine with the value 20.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:14B0
name: allocate_zeroed_block
description: Obtains a size from another routine and allocates a block of that size through another routine. When the allocation succeeds it clears every byte of the block to zero. It returns the block address, or zero when the allocation fails.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:1:0000
name: run_installer_main_sequence
description: Second-segment entry of the installer whose visible code copies a name into a length-limited buffer and opens a file with a fixed mode value. It then writes a long sequence of fixed-width text and numeric fields to that file and reads one character to test for N or n. It also calls jump stubs for dos.Lock, dos.UnLock, dos.Write and dos.Delay, and the pseudo-code is truncated, so the later steps are not described.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:1:0ADA
name: copy_text_or_close_file
description: Copies a length-prefixed text into a result buffer when a stack-space check passes and returns the buffer. Otherwise it calls another routine with the file handle stored in the context and returns the result of another routine called with zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:1:0AF4
name: copy_text_or_release_buffer
description: Copies a length-prefixed text into a result buffer when a stack-space check passes and returns the buffer. Otherwise it calls another routine with the buffer stored in the context, calls another routine with the file handle, and returns the result of another routine called with one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:1:0B1C
name: copy_text_or_read_byte
description: Copies a length-prefixed text into a result buffer when a stack-space check passes. Otherwise it reads up to three bytes from the file handle stored in the context into a fixed field and returns that first byte when the read result is below two, and zero otherwise.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:1:0B4A
name: copy_text_or_write_output
description: Copies a length-prefixed text into a result buffer when a stack-space check passes. Otherwise it calls another routine with its argument, then writes the argument through the file handle stored in the context using the length that call returned, and returns the write result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:1:0B78
name: copy_text_or_poll_value
description: Copies a length-prefixed text into a result buffer when a stack-space check passes. Otherwise it calls another routine in a loop until that routine returns a nonzero value and returns that value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:1:0BA0
name: allocate_zeroed_buffer
description: Gets a size from another routine, allocates that many bytes through another routine and clears every byte to zero when the allocation succeeds. It returns the address, or zero when the allocation fails.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:1:0BAC
name: open_file_with_error_record
description: When a flag field in the context is set it calls another routine first. It clears an error value and calls the open routine through a library offset. When the result is zero it stores the DOS error code, sets error code 2 and returns minus one; otherwise it returns the handle.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:1:0BB2
name: release_record_and_report
description: Looks up a record from its parameter and returns minus one when none is found. When the record flag bit 16 is clear it calls another routine with the record second field, clears the record pointer, and returns minus one if an error flag in the context is set. When the flag is set it clears the record pointer and returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:1:0BB8
name: close_handle_and_return_zero
description: Calls another routine first when a pending-error field in the context is set. It then calls dos.Close through a library offset and returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:1:0BBE
name: compare_c_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings character by character. It returns minus one when the first string is smaller at the first difference, one when it is larger, and zero when both strings are equal.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:1:0BC4
name: calculate_string_length
description: Advances a pointer until it finds the zero byte that ends a string and returns the distance from the original pointer to that terminator.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:1:0BCA
name: dispatch_handle_operation
description: Looks up an entry from the parameter and returns minus one when no entry is found. Otherwise it calls another routine with a field of the entry and the two remaining parameters, and returns minus one if an error flag in the context is set.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:1:0BD0
name: set_tracked_block_pointer
description: When given a nonzero pointer it calls another routine with zero and stores the pointer minus four bytes in the context as the tracked block, returning the result of that call. With a zero argument it returns zero and changes nothing.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:1:0BD6
name: create_directory_or_record_error
description: Attempts to create a directory through dos library calls. When the create call returns zero it stores the DOS error code in the context and returns minus one; otherwise it releases the lock it obtained with dos.UnLock and returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:1:0BE8
name: emit_string_characters
description: Walks a zero-terminated string one character at a time. While a counter in the context stays positive it stores each character at the current buffer position and advances it, and otherwise it passes the character to another routine. It finishes by passing a sentinel to that routine and returns the string length.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:1:0BF4
name: flush_pending_output_entries
description: Walks a linked list of entries whose head is stored in the context. For each entry with the flag bit 2 set, the flag bit 4 clear and a nonzero pending length, it calls another routine with the entry data pointer, its start value and the pending length. It then calls another routine with the parameter.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:1:0C00
name: claim_free_handle_slot
description: Finds the first free record in a table of eight-byte handle records, starting at the fourth record. It fills the record from a call made with a mode chosen from the flag bits in the parameter and stores a sequence value with the returned handle. It sets error code 24 when no record is free and error code 22 when the flags are invalid.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:1:0C06
name: dispatch_flagged_entry_operation
description: Looks up an entry from the parameter and returns minus one when the lookup finds nothing. When a flag bit in the entry is set it calls another routine with a zero offset and a value of two first, then calls a second routine with a field of the entry and returns minus one if an error flag in the context is set.

key: runtime segment $06B6E0-$06BBD0:0:0004
name: access_cia_ports_and_custom
description: A 101-instruction routine that the reference run entered from outside the static flow. It touches the CIAA port A register, which the register note says carries the joystick or mouse fire buttons and disk status, the CIAB port B register and the custom chip base, and it calls two unnamed routines. The pseudo-code is unavailable, so the direction of each access is not known.

key: runtime segment $06B6E0-$06BBD0:0:0182
name: reset_state_after_delay
description: When bit 8 of a global state value is set it runs a countdown loop of 100 steps, clears bit 64 of that value, and then sets the state value to 8. The facts list the CIA control registers and the interrupt request register for this routine, but the pseudo-code shows only the state value.

key: runtime segment $06B6E0-$06BBD0:0:01C0
name: run_flagged_callback_sequence
description: When bit 32 of a global state value is set it calls another routine four times and then sets the state value to 32. The facts list the interrupt request register and a custom chip register at offset 31 for this routine.

key: runtime segment $06B6E0-$06BBD0:0:01E8
name: advance_global_counter_cycle
description: When a global counter is zero it adds 273 to it, and if the result is 4095 it resets the counter to one. When the counter is nonzero it decrements it by one.

key: runtime segment $06B6E0-$06BBD0:0:023E
name: render_font_characters_to_plane
description: Runs only when the low nibble of a global counter equals 14. It copies blocks of 230 longwords between two regions and moves 60 words into a staging buffer. For each character of a text string it computes a position in a character table from the character code minus 32, combines shifted rows into a bitmap buffer and copies 19-word rows to the destination.

key: runtime segment $06B6E0-$06BBD0:0:036A
name: wrap_counter_and_store_offsets
description: Decrements a global counter by 16 twice. When the high nibble of the result equals 15 it sets the global to one, copies the counter value into a short variable, and stores two further short values that are offset from it by 5888 and 11776. Otherwise it returns without change.

key: runtime segment $06B6E0-$06BBD0:0:03C6
name: copy_tile_block_with_wrap
description: Decrements a global pointer counter and, when it reaches zero, resets it to 100. It then copies a block of 22 groups of 21 words from one buffer to another, advancing both pointers by fixed strides.

key: runtime segment $06B6E0-$06BBD0:0:0416
name: initialise_copper_and_interrupts
description: Clears a block of 8832 longwords starting at a fixed address and stores values into several global fields, including a copper list pointer and interrupt handler entries. It then writes the copper location and jump registers, the DMA control register and the interrupt enable and request registers, setting DMA and interrupt enable bits.

key: runtime segment $C24210-$C24250:0:0004
name: return_stack_top_value
description: A two-instruction routine that returns the eight-byte value found at the top of the stack and does no other work. The reference run entered it from outside the static flow.

key: runtime segment $C53170-$C531C0:0:000E
name: clear_word_at_pointer
description: A two-instruction routine that writes zero to the 16-bit word addressed by the A0 register and then returns.
